dialogues.speaker: The Steambird
dialogues.text: "Stunning Twist! Merchant Drowning Years Ago Turned Out to Be a Premeditated Murder!"

dialogues.speaker: The Steambird
dialogues.text: Breaking News: A diver recently uncovered items belonging to the late jeweler Brandt on the Salacia Plain, unraveling a years-old case of the victim's alleged accidental drowning.

dialogues.speaker: The Steambird
dialogues.text: The new evidence has completely overturned previous findings on the case. The case was no accident, but premeditated murder!

dialogues.speaker: The Steambird
dialogues.text: What is the truth behind the case? Stay tuned for our upcoming reports!
